findings.evidence: roadmap README §0.4 line 324 and acceptance item 1 line 1175 name `multiplicity`; Counterexamples.lean:45,54 use the bare lambda; Counterexamples.lean:66 names `leadingEnergy` for the other roadmap example.
findings.fix: Add `def multiplicity : Observable V := fun s => (Multiset.card s : ℝ)` with `multiplicity_cons`/`multiplicity_zero` restatements, and state both negative results about it. Otherwise the deferred §0.3 item ("jet multiplicity is not soft safe at any order") and later layers will respell the lambda and these theorems will not apply to it syntactically.
findings.issue: `not_isCollinearSafe_card` (line 44) and `not_isInfraredSafe_card` (line 53) are stated about the inline lambda `fun s : Multiset V => (Multiset.card s : ℝ)`; no `multiplicity` observable is exposed, although the roadmap names it as a product (§0.4: "Prove that `multiplicity s = (s.momenta.card : ℝ)` is neither collinear safe nor infrared safe", acceptance example 1) and the PR claims to close that half. The sibling counterexample `leadingEnergy` is named (line 66) and given full API, so the two are treated inconsistently.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:72-77 define `splitCollinear` and `splitCollinear_def`; grep over both new files shows no `mem_splitCollinear` or `count_splitCollinear`.
findings.fix: Add `theorem mem_splitCollinear {p q : V} {z : ℝ} {s : Multiset V} : q ∈ splitCollinear p z s ↔ q = z • p ∨ q = (1 - z) • p ∨ q ∈ s.erase p`, marked `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `splitCollinear` has no membership lemma. Its body is (correctly) unexposed, so a consumer asking what is in a split final state must rewrite with `splitCollinear_def` and then unfold `Multiset.mem_cons`/`Multiset.mem_erase_of_ne` by hand. The `mem_*` restatement is the characteristic lemma for a multiset-valued definition and the clustering/cone safety proofs of Layers 1–2 will consume it.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:79 `@[simp] splitCollinear_cons_self`, :114 `@[simp] card_splitCollinear {p} (z) {s} (hp : p ∈ s)`, :123 `@[simp] sum_splitCollinear` — versus :90-98 with no attribute on either degenerate-fraction lemma.
findings.issue: `splitCollinear_zero` (line 91) and `splitCollinear_one` (line 96) rewrite the defined constant away to `0 ::ₘ s` but carry no `@[simp]`, while the other hypothesis-carrying lemmas about the same definition — `card_splitCollinear` (line 114) and `sum_splitCollinear` (line 123) — and `splitCollinear_cons_self` (line 79) are all `@[simp]`. Conditional rewriting discharges `p ∈ s` the same way in all five cases.

summary: Exposure discipline and the safety-predicate API are sound (bodies hidden, `_def`/`_iff` restatements present, no compatibility surface), but the multiplicity counterexample is stated against an anonymous lambda instead of the roadmap's named `multiplicity` observable, `splitCollinear` lacks a membership characterisation, and two of its degenerate-case lemmas are missing `@[simp]` while their siblings carry it.
